decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD sits close to the label's core expertise in compilations and reissues, so the firm can interpret its results and keep it in a warehouse-backed catalog at little cost, though limited R&D and missing recent evidence add some risk.

The illustrated release series is a product line that builds on the firm's established curation and production know-how, which lets management learn from early results and add further models rather than abandon the line.
Reissued jazz vinyl is the label's core competence of reissuing overlooked music, so related knowledge is high and the item fits the firm's direction of broadening formats.
The multi-disc box set is close to the established offer, but limited-edition box sets often sell out and leave the catalog, which raises the chance of removal despite good knowledge fit.
This compilation CD fits the firm's existing knowledge, but it was only mentioned rather than featured on a page of its own and the firm lacks its own R&D, so the risk of quiet removal is moderate.
